text: Freeze autonomy benchmark v3 with calibration-derived budgets
description: Create a versioned v3 execution contract before new treatment evidence. Reuse the unchanged four v2 fixtures and unchanged capability/efficiency decision rules, but freeze gpt-5.6-sol, workspace-write-no-network, 170000 tokens and 90000 ms per run as derived by excluded pilots, alternating matched order, no retries, and eight required runs. Export a v3 protocol manifest and analyzer wrapper that reports version 2026-08-01.v3 while delegating unchanged scoring semantics to v2. Add deterministic tests for exact manifest values, v3 result versioning, and invalid incomplete evidence. Do not launch live agents in this aim.

reflections.context: Excluded pilots derived prospective limits after v2 became invalid under an uncalibrated 100000-token ceiling.
reflections.outcome: Added frozen protocol 2026-08-01.v3 with gpt-5.6-sol, workspace-write-no-network, 170000 tokens, 90000 ms, eight required alternating matched runs, zero retries, unchanged v2 fixtures, and unchanged v2 scoring. Added a v3 analyzer wrapper and tests for exact manifest values, versioned efficiency output, and invalid incomplete evidence.
reflections.effectiveness: The version boundary prevents calibrated limits from retroactively modifying v2 and makes the next confirmatory run reproducible. Verification: 121/121 tests, tsc --noEmit, and git diff --check pass. No live v3 agents launched.
reflections.lesson: When only resource limits change after calibration, freeze a new execution protocol while reusing task and scoring versions explicitly.
reflections.pattern: Version execution manifests independently from fixtures and scoring when prospective calibration changes budgets.

status.comment: Prospective v3 manifest and analyzer wrapper implemented and fully verified; awaiting user acceptance. No live v3 evidence collected.

valueRationale: A versioned prospective manifest prevents calibrated limits from being confused with post-hoc modifications to the invalid v2 experiment.
